steps.setupFirstGame: Set up the board and the pieces for the first game as the rulebook describes.
steps.removeProbeCards: Put these probe cards back in the box, they are out of this game ({{count}}): {{cards}}.
steps.setAsideReferenceStack: Set the remaining probe cards aside face up as a reference stack: the app keeps the probe deck.
steps.placeLocationPlaceholder: Put a face-down placeholder on the "Rebel Base" space: the app keeps the base secret.
steps.registerBaseCard: Choose your base system, take its probe card from the reference stack and put it face down on the "Rebel Base" space, then register it below.
steps.returnLeaders: Return these leaders to their pools: {{leaders}}.
steps.takeProbeCards: Take these probe cards from the reference stack into your hand: {{cards}}.
steps.opponentDrewProbeCards_one: The opponent drew {{count}} probe card (kept by the app, nothing to do).
steps.opponentDrewProbeCards_other: The opponent drew {{count}} probe cards (kept by the app, nothing to do).
steps.advanceTime: Move the time marker from {{from}} to {{to}}.
steps.revealBase: Take the {{system}} card from the reference stack and put it face up on the "Rebel Base" space; remove the placeholder.
steps.revealOwnBase: Turn your base card {{system}} face up.
steps.moveBaseUnits: Move the units of the "Rebel Base" space to {{system}}.

happened.registerBase: Your base has not been registered yet.
happened.baseRevealed: The Rebel base has been revealed.

waiting.ai: AI waits for the table to be confirmed
waiting.over: Game over: finish syncing the table
